text:
maria: sharing Orchid POC perf run — attached heatmap & quick notes. baseline 1k qps, 0.2% >250ms tail.
kevin: thanks, can you paste the load profile? was it steady or Poisson?
maria: steady ramp to 1k over 10m, held 20m, then spike to 1.5k for 5m. logs: `ramp(0,1000,600s)` and spike window.
vikram: saw higher jitter on sequence length >512 — KV cache miss rate spiked. rough numbers: avg latency 45ms, p95 210ms, p99 340ms at 1k qps. p99 dropped to 180ms when enabling prefix cache.
kevin: do we have cost delta estimate for prefix cache vs no-cache?
vikram: ~12% increase in throughput per-GPU, token cost down ~8% because of fewer tokens generated in re-runs. Will quantify.
amy: legal/security asked about data retention during POC.
ops-bot: audit-log retention set to 7d for this workspace per request.
maria: client asked about SLA for steady 1k qps with 200ms p95. can we promise?
vikram: we can target p95<200ms with dedicated pool + prefix cache + 2x replication. need to reserve 4x gpus for burst safety. ops: need dedicated contract.
kevin: note to pricing: add dedicated cushion + HSM KMS add-on. sales-eng: @sales-eng can you draft quote for 4 GPU dedicated, pref cache enable, 3 month POC.
simon: I'll run a focused AB test tomorrow comparing quantized model variant — expecting 10% cheaper but p99 increases.
maria: great — client wants runbook for cutover. can we share a short ops checklist?
vikram: copy runbook snippet:
```
1) deploy model-v1 (quant)
2) warm KV cache with 1000 prefix requests
3) ramp 0->1000 qps over 10m
4) monitor p95/p99 and abort at p99>500ms
```
kevin: looks good. i'll send updated quote + runbook to client today. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. tagging @legal for retention confirmation.
